summary: After long time Yahweh gave rest to Israel from all enemies, Joshua old advanced in years calls all Israel elders heads judges officers says you have seen all Yahweh has done to all these nations for Yahweh your God is he who has fought for you, behold I have allotted to you these nations remaining to be inheritance for your tribes from Jordan with all nations I cut off to great sea westward, Yahweh will drive them out from before you and give you rest. Therefore be very courageous to keep and do all that is written in book of law of Moses that you not come among these nations remaining, make mention of name of their gods nor cause to swear nor serve nor bow, but cling to Yahweh as you have done to this day, for Yahweh has driven out great nations, one man of you shall chase thousand for Yahweh fights for you as he spoke. Take good heed therefore to love Yahweh your God, else if you go back and cling to remnant of these nations intermarry go in to them they in to you, know for certain Yahweh will no more drive out these nations but they shall be snares traps scourges in sides thorns in eyes until you perish from good land Yahweh gave. Behold today I am going way of all earth, you know in all hearts not one thing failed of all good things Yahweh spoke concerning you all have come to pass not one failed, therefore as all good things have come now likewise Yahweh will bring upon you all evil things until he have destroyed you from good land, when you transgress covenant and go serve other gods bow, then anger will burn and you shall perish quickly from good land.
whyItMatters: Joshua's farewell — take good heed to love Yahweh, be very courageous keep law, cling to Yahweh, and warning that remaining nations will become snares if intermarry, and not one thing failed of all good things — all came to pass.

keyVerses.text: You have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is Yahweh your God who has fought for you.
keyVerses.why: You have seen — Yahweh is he who fought for you.

keyVerses.text: but hold fast to Yahweh your God, as you have done to this day.
keyVerses.why: Cling — dabaq — same as Ruth clings, marriage language.

keyVerses.text: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which Yahweh your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.
keyVerses.why: Not one thing failed — all good things came to pass.

questions.question: What does 'be very courageous to keep and do all written in book of law, but cling to Yahweh' mean?
questions.answer: Be very courageous (same as ch1) but now to keep law, not just to fight — courage to obey, not to come among remaining nations, not make mention of their gods nor swear nor serve nor bow. Cling (dabaq) to Yahweh — same word as Ruth clings to Naomi, man cleaves to wife, Israel clings to Yahweh. As you have done to this day — commendation. One man chase thousand for Yahweh fights — small can defeat many because God fights. Take good heed to love Yahweh — love is guarded action.

questions.question: Why warning that remaining nations will be snares traps scourges thorns if intermarry?
questions.answer: Joshua allotted nations remaining still to be driven out. If go back and cling to remnant intermarry go in to them they in to you, know certainly Yahweh will no more drive out but they shall be snares traps scourges in sides thorns in eyes until perish from good land. Snares traps scourges thorns — images of entangling and pain. Intermarriage leads to serving their gods, syncretism, loss of distinct identity. History of Judges shows exactly this — remaining nations become snare. Not ethnic hatred but religious danger — serving other gods.

questions.question: What does 'not one thing failed of all good things, all came to pass' mean for faith?
questions.answer: Joshua says behold today I am going way of all earth (about to die), you know in all hearts souls not one thing failed of all good things Yahweh spoke concerning you all came to pass not one failed. Testimony of fulfilled promise — every good promise about land, rest, driving out — came true. Therefore as all good things came, likewise Yahweh will bring evil if transgress covenant serve other gods — good and evil both come to pass if conditions met. For readers, remembrance of faithfulness grounds warning: God who kept good will also keep warning. Not one thing failed is repeated in 1 Kings 8:56 Solomon says same.

glossary.def: Cleave, cling, stick — like marriage, Ruth clings to Naomi, Israel to Yahweh.
Images of entanglement and pain if intermarry and serve other gods — remaining nations become snare.
All good things came to pass — testimony of fulfilled promise, basis for warning.
